2607.24167.title: Falsifiable Commitment Planning for Self-Correcting Web Agents
2607.24167.paper_summary: Long-horizon web agents often go off track before final failure: a trajectory can remain locally plausible even after the current state, reused skill, or plan assumption no longer supports the user instruction. Existing agents can plan, reflect, or reuse experience, but their plans rarely specify the evidence under which an active step should still be trusted. We propose FCPAgent, a falsifiable commitment planning framework for robust long-horizon web agents. FCPAgent represents each plan step as a Falsifiable Commitment Unit (FCU): a subgoal grounded in a reusable skill, together with confirming evidence, falsifying evidence, and a confidence score. Execution is organized as a plan-test-repair loop. The hybrid commitment testing module checks candidate actions before they modify the browser and checks observations after execution; for efficiency, it combines lightweight evidence matching with LLM-based diagnostic verification. When evidence falsifies a commitment, scope-aware repair localizes the contradiction to the execution, skill, or planning level and revises the smallest adequate part. On WebArena, FCPAgent achieves a 13.8% relative improvement in average success over the strongest baseline, with especially large gains on long-horizon tasks.
2607.24167.paper_summary_zh: 長期目標的網路代理在最終失敗之前經常會偏離軌道：即使當前狀態、重用的技能或計畫假設不再支持用戶指令，軌跡仍然可以在局部上看起來合理。現有的代理可以計畫、反思或重用經驗，但它們的計畫很少具體說明在什麼證據下，某個主動步驟仍然應該被信任。我們提出了FCPAgent，一個可證偽的承諾計畫框架，旨在為穩健的長期網路代理提供支持。FCPAgent將每個計畫步驟表示為一個可證偽的承諾單元（FCU）：一個基於可重用技能的子目標，連同確認證據、反駁證據和信心分數。執行被組織為計畫-測試-修復循環。混合承諾測試模組在候選行動修改瀏覽器之前檢查它們，並在執行後檢查觀察結果；為了提高效率，它將輕量級證據匹配與基於LLM的診斷驗證相結合。當證據反駁一個承諾時，範圍感知修復將矛盾本地化到執行、技能或計畫層面，並修訂最小的足夠部分。在WebArena上，FCPAgent在平均成功率上相對於最強基準實現了13.8%的改進，尤其在長期任務上獲得了特別大的增益。
